pages.text: Bugs that hunt will not hunt anyone wearing gold. They never take offence at a gold wearer, and a chase ends the moment gold goes on.

$(item)Bound by the rule$()$(br)Golden silverfish$(br)Scorpions, of every colour$(br)Omen beetles$(br)Moths, of every variant, rare or not$(br2)Only aggression is covered. Gold does not break the gaze of a rare moth.
